title: Career Roadmap: Design Researcher
summary: Investigate user needs, behaviours, challenges and experiences to help design teams create useful, accessible and effective products, services and digital experiences.

facts.Current degree: Liberal Arts / Liberal Studies (BA / B.Sc Liberal Arts & Sciences)

about.label: Education Pathway
about.text: Liberal Arts / Liberal Studies – Design & Innovation Studies

blocks.text: Investigate user needs, behaviours, challenges and experiences to help design teams create useful, accessible and effective products, services and digital experiences.

rows.text: Any stream; develop observation, communication, research and creative-thinking skills
Liberal Arts degree in Design & Innovation Studies, Design, Psychology, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field
UX research, service design, human-centred design, interaction design or design strategy
Master's in Design Research, HCI, Interaction Design, Service Design or a related specialization

blocks.label: Alternative pathways
blocks.text: Degrees in Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology or Communication can also lead to design research when supported by practical UX research skills and a portfolio.

blocks.label: User Research
blocks.text: Interviews, surveys, contextual inquiry and usability testing.

blocks.label: Research Methods
blocks.text: Qualitative coding, quantitative analysis, observation and research planning.

blocks.label: Human-Centred Design
blocks.text: User journeys, personas, empathy mapping and problem framing.

blocks.label: Tools
blocks.text: Figma, Miro, FigJam, spreadsheets and research documentation tools.

blocks.label: Communication
blocks.text: Research reports, insight presentations and collaboration with designers and product teams.

blocks.label: Ethics & Accessibility
blocks.text: Informed consent, privacy, inclusive research and accessibility awareness.
Create three or four research case studies:

blocks.label: User Interview Study
blocks.text: Investigate a real user problem and synthesize recurring themes.

blocks.label: Usability Evaluation
blocks.text: Test a website or app with consenting participants and recommend improvements.

blocks.label: Journey Mapping
blocks.text: Map a service experience, identify pain points and suggest changes.

blocks.label: Accessibility Research
blocks.text: Evaluate a digital experience against accessibility principles.

blocks.label: Concept Validation
blocks.text: Compare alternative product concepts using structured user feedback.
Each case study should include the research question, method, participant approach, findings, limitations and design recommendations.
Target placements at:

items.text: Service design and social innovation organizations.

blocks.text: Search for UX Research Intern, Design Research Intern, User Research Intern, Product Research Intern and Service Design Intern roles.
Prioritize:

items.text: UX research methods and usability testing.

blocks.text: Practical research experience and strong case studies usually provide more convincing evidence of readiness than certificates alone.
Design / UX Research Intern
Junior Design Researcher / UX Researcher
Design Researcher / Senior UX Researcher
Research Lead → Head of Research / Design Strategy Lead
Progression depends on research quality, methodological depth, product impact and the complexity of projects managed.

rows.text: Learn interviewing, usability testing, research ethics and basic qualitative analysis.
Conduct a small ethical user study and develop a research case study.
Build two portfolio case studies, practise research presentations and apply for internships.

blocks.label: Target-ready profile
blocks.text: Strong research methods, user empathy, qualitative and quantitative analysis, clear communication and a portfolio showing how research insights inform design decisions.
